question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open the tracking link in your order confirmation email, or enter your order number on the Track Order page. Tracking updates within 24 hours after your order ships.

question: I did not receive my order confirmation email.
answer: Please check your spam or promotions folder first. If it is not there, open the Orders page in your account and choose Resend confirmation, or contact support with your phone number.

question: Can I change my order after placing it?
answer: You can change items, size or address within 1 hour of placing the order from the Orders page. After that the order is packed and cannot be edited, but you can return items once they arrive.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to the Orders page and choose Cancel order before it ships. If it has already shipped, refuse the delivery or start a return when it arrives. Refunds for cancelled orders take 5 to 7 business days.

question: My order has not arrived yet. What should I do?
answer: If your order is more than 3 days past the estimated delivery date, contact support with your order number. We will trace the parcel and send a replacement or refund if it is lost.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Yes, as long as the order has not shipped. Contact support with your order number and the new address as soon as possible.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking and popular wallets. Cash on delivery is also available on orders below Rs. 5,000.

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery is available on orders below Rs. 5,000 for a small fee of Rs. 40. Please keep the exact amount ready for the delivery partner.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments can fail because of wrong card details, a bank limit or a network problem. Try again or use another method. If money was deducted, it is refunded automatically within 5 to 7 business days.

question: Can I get an invoice for my order?
answer: Yes. Your invoice is attached to the confirmation email and is also available to download from the Orders page.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Metro cities are often faster. You will see an estimated date at checkout before you pay.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 999. For smaller orders, standard shipping costs Rs. 59.

question: Do you offer express delivery?
answer: Yes. Express delivery costs Rs. 149 and arrives in 1 to 2 business days. Order before 2 pm to get it dispatched the same day.

question: Do you deliver to my pincode?
answer: We deliver to most pincodes across India. Enter your pincode on the product page or in the cart to check availability and delivery time.
keywords: do you deliver to my city

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Not yet. At the moment we deliver only within India.

question: Can I send an order to someone else as a gift?
answer: Yes. Enter the recipient's address at checkout and tick the gift option to add a message. The price will not appear on the packing slip.

question: What if I am not home when the order is delivered?
answer: The delivery partner will try 3 times and call you before each attempt. You can also ask them to reschedule, or contact us to arrange a new delivery date.

question: Do you deliver on Sundays and public holidays?
answer: We deliver Monday to Saturday. There are no deliveries on Sundays or public holidays, so those days are not counted in delivery estimates.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging. Start the return from the Orders page.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Open the Orders page, choose Return item, select a reason and pick a pickup slot. Pack the item in its original packaging and hand it to the pickup agent.

question: How long do refunds take?
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after we receive and check the returned item. The money goes back to your original payment method.
keywords: when will i get my money back

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
answer: Yes. You can exchange within 30 days, subject to stock. Choose Exchange instead of Return on the Orders page and pick the new size or colour.

question: My item arrived damaged. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry about that. Send a photo of the item and the packaging to support within 48 hours of delivery, and we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Personalised items, innerwear and other hygiene products, gift cards and items marked Final Sale cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged.

question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
answer: Return pickup is free if the item is damaged or wrong. For change-of-mind returns, Rs. 49 is deducted from your refund to cover pickup.

question: I received the wrong item.
answer: Please contact support within 48 hours with your order number and a photo of what you received. We will send the correct item free of charge and arrange pickup of the wrong one.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign up at the top of the page, enter your email and a password, and confirm the verification email. It takes less than a minute.

question: Can I order without an account?
answer: Yes. Choose Guest checkout at the payment step. Creating an account later lets you track orders and save addresses.

question: I forgot my password.
answer: Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. We will send a reset link that stays valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I place an order?
answer: Add items to your cart, open the cart, choose Checkout, enter your address, pick a payment method and confirm. You will get a confirmation email straight away.

question: How do I use a discount code?
answer: Enter the code in the Promo code box at checkout and click Apply before you pay. Only one code can be used per order, and some sale items are excluded.

question: Do you have a size guide?
answer: Yes. Every clothing product page has a Size guide link with measurements in centimetres. If you are between sizes, we suggest choosing the larger one.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Chat with me here, or email support@willow.example. Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm.

question: Do you sell gift cards?
answer: Yes. Digital gift cards come in amounts from Rs. 500 to Rs. 10,000 and are valid for 12 months. They arrive by email within minutes.

question: How do I get a discount on my first order?
answer: Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of any page and you will receive a 10 percent discount code for your first order by email.
